fusions.name: Pile Driver
fusions.desc: Anchors every other arm and slams one down, dealing 20 damage and stunning the target for 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil Drop
fusions.desc: Brings the heaviest arm down on one enemy, dealing 40 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Heavy Hand
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Level Footing
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 18% of the target's armour.
